title: react-dom 19.3.0 bump in console-lab and console-ui
summary: This change bumps the `react-dom` dependency from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0 in two workspace packages — the `console-lab` app and the `console-ui` component library — while leaving `react` itself pinned at 18.3.1. The lockfile is regenerated accordingly: the old `react-dom@18.3.1` / `scheduler@0.23.2` pair is dropped, `react-dom@19.3.0` / `scheduler@0.28.0` is added, and every peer-resolved snapshot that depended on react-dom (react-aria, react-aria-components, @testing-library/react) is re-resolved against the new version. The result is a mixed React 18 runtime / React 19 renderer pairing across the console workspace.
